description: This Java source file defines a class `LoggingReceiver` that extends `MidiReceiver`. It processes incoming MIDI messages by converting them to formatted strings, timestamps, and logs the messages via a `ScopeLogger` as well as Android's Logcat.

classes.name: LoggingReceiver
classes.description: A MIDI receiver that logs incoming MIDI messages with timestamps, formatting the data and message, and writes them to a ScopeLogger as well as Logcat.

methods.name: LoggingReceiver
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the receiver with a ScopeLogger and records the start time in nanoseconds.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Overrides the MidiReceiver's onSend method to process incoming MIDI data, add a timestamp, format, log and output the message.
